# windows-settings

> Windows developer workstation configuration, 17-theme 24-bit TrueColor palette engine, Zellij 0.46+ and Neovim Named Pipe RPC IDE and AI agent fleet manager, and idempotent PowerShell 7+, `cmd.exe`, and Windows Terminal automation.

## Overview

`github.com/lock14/windows-settings` provisions and synchronizes a low-latency Windows CLI and terminal IDE environment. It combines an autoloaded PowerShell 7 module (`WindowsSettings`), a zero-dependency native `cmd.exe` AutoRun environment, a 17-theme TrueColor engine adhering to a 3-tier universal semantic color contract across 40 languages, and a daemon-free multi-agent terminal IDE built on Zellij `0.46+` (`OSC 7501` Attention Inbox and 1-hop GPU `zellij terminal`) and Windows Named Pipe Neovim RPC (`\\.\pipe\nvim-ide-<session>`).

## Quick start

```powershell
# Turnkey one-liner bootstrap
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lock14/windows-settings/main/bootstrap.ps1 | iex

# Declarative Microsoft DSC v3 provisioning
winget configure .\configuration.dsc.yaml

# Local clone and modular setup
git clone https://github.com/lock14/windows-settings.git
cd windows-settings
.\setup.ps1 -Bootstrap
.\setup.ps1 -DotfilesOnly -Theme solarized-dark
.\setup.ps1 -DryRun
```

## Core components

- `setup.ps1` and `bootstrap.ps1`: Idempotent provisioning, timestamped `.bak_<timestamp>` diff backups, `-Theme <slug|holiday>`, `-DryRun`, and clean `-Uninstall*` orchestrators.
- `configuration.dsc.yaml` and `mise.toml`: Declarative WinGet DSC v3 packages and pinned polyglot runtimes and CLI tools (`bat`, `delta`, `dust`, `elan`, `eza`, `fd`, `fzf`, `gh`, `glow`, `go`, `java`, `jq`, `neovim`, `node`, `python`, `ripgrep`, `rust`, `sd`, `tealdeer`, `tree-sitter`, `yq`, `zellij`, `zoxide`).
- `module/` (`WindowsSettings` v3.0.0): Autoloaded PowerShell module exporting 82 functions across `Navigation.ps1`, `Git.ps1`, `Developer.ps1`, `Utilities.ps1`, and `Completions.ps1`, with compiled disk caching and non-blocking `<branch>@<N>` OSC 8 pull and merge request badge synchronization.
- `config/themes/`: 17 canonical 24-bit TrueColor `.theme` specifications covering 9 classic developer palettes (`solarized-dark`, `solarized-light`, `catppuccin-mocha`, `catppuccin-latte`, `gruvbox-dark`, `tokyonight-night`, `kanagawa-wave`, `nord`, `onedark`) and 8 US Holiday palettes (`new-years`, `valentines`, `st-patricks`, `easter`, `independence-day`, `halloween`, `thanksgiving`, `christmas`).
- `config/zellij/`: Declarative Zellij `0.46+` `config.kdl`, frameless `ide-3pane.kdl` (Inverted-T) and `ide-2pane.kdl` layouts, right-click IDE `context_menu`, `themes/windows-settings.kdl`, `OSC 7501` Attention Inbox, and `zellij terminal` GPU desktop app settings.
- `plugin/ws-bar/`: Optional Rust `wasm32-wasip1` 1-line `BASE02` Zellij top-bar plugin overriding the `compact-bar` alias with clickable `AI`, `Editor`, `Shell`, `ZOOM`, `SYNC`, `Attention`, `Fleet`, `Monitor`, and `Help` pills, mode-contextual key hints, and automatic built-in `zellij:bars` fallback.
- `config/nvim/` and `config/vim/_vimrc`: Neovim 0.11+ and 0.12+ Lua configuration (Native LSP, Lazy.nvim, 43 Tree-sitter `.scm` queries, `mini.files`, `render-markdown.nvim`, Named Pipe RPC, `:Theme`) plus standalone 17-theme `_vimrc`.
- `config/bat/` and `config/colors/LS_COLORS`: 17 `*-TrueColor.tmTheme` files, 37 standalone `.sublime-syntax` grammars, and 40-language calibrated `LS_COLORS`.
- `config/powershell/`, `config/cmd/autorun.cmd`, and `config/cmd/macros.doskey`: Minimal 1-line `$PROFILE`, streaming Base02 shelf Oh My Posh theme (`p10k_single_line.omp.json`), and UTF-8 `cmd.exe` AutoRun prompt and `doskey /macrofile` parity.
- `config/terminal/`: Zero-touch Windows Terminal JSON Fragment (`windows-settings.json`) and `settings.json` with all 17 schemes and `Alt+*` pass-through to Zellij.
- `tests/test_settings.ps1`: Automated validation suite covering syntax, manifests, themes, module exports, CLI utilities, Git safety guards, prompt rendering, line endings, documentation typography, and setup idempotency.

## Native CLI utilities (`bin/`)

Every utility ships as a dual-execution pair (`<name>.ps1` and `<name>.cmd`):

- `theme`: Unified 17-theme TrueColor engine (`--list`, `--plain`, `--current`, `--set <slug>`, `--preview <slug>`, `--holiday`, `--create <slug> --from <base>`, `--sync-assets`, `--dry-run`, and interactive `fzf` picker).
- `ide`: Zellij `0.46+` and Neovim Named Pipe IDE and AI agent fleet manager (`--3pane`, `--2pane`, `--ai agy|claude|codex`, `-d`, `--detach`, `--desktop`, `-s`, `--sessions`, `--next-attention`, `--open [+line] <file>`, `--cd <dir>`, `--send <text>`, `--monitor`, `--keys`, `--quit`, `--backend zellij|wt`, `--dry-run`).
- `update-system` (`update`): Unified updater across `winget`, `mise` (with `mise_paths` refresh), PowerShell modules, `rustup` and `elan` toolchains, Neovim plugins, `tldr` and `bat` caches, and compiled shell and IDE startup caches (`--system-only`, `--skip-winget`, `--skip-mise`, `--skip-modules`, `--skip-nvim`, `--dry-run`).
- `gen-passwd`: Cryptographically secure RNG password generator (`-Length`, `-Count`, `-NoSymbols`).
- `sum`: Streaming numeric accumulator accepting CLI arguments and piped stdin.
- `repeat-until-success`: Command retry runner (`-MaxAttempts`, `-DelaySeconds`).
- `install-nerd-fonts`: Automated MesloLGS Nerd Font Mono installer.

## Key design invariants

- **Zero personal paths**: Use `$HOME`, `$env:LOCALAPPDATA`, `$env:APPDATA`, and `Join-Path`; never hardcode usernames.
- **Line-ending contract**: `.ps1`, `.psm1`, `.psd1`, `.cmd`, `.bat`, and `.doskey` strictly use `CRLF`; `.md`, `.json`, `.kdl`, `.yml`, `.yaml`, `.toml`, `.lock`, `.rs`, `.lua`, `.scm`, `.theme`, `.txt`, and `LICENSE` strictly use `LF`.
- **Git safety separation**: `gprune` deletes merged branches only (`git branch -d`); `gpurge` force-deletes unmerged branches (`git branch -D`) behind confirmation; `gsync` refuses dirty working trees; `guser-branch` refuses to rename `main` or `master`.
- **3-tier semantic color contract**: `YELLOW` is exclusive to control flow; `BASE0` holds invocations, qualifiers, and custom domain types; `BLUE` marks routine declarations and section headers; `GREEN` marks declarations and primitive types.
